content.text: Contents Defining Open in Open Data, Open Content and Open Knowledge The Open Definition The Open Definition sets out principles that define “openness” in relation to data and content. It makes precise the meaning of “open” in the terms “open data” and “open content” and thereby ensures quality and encourages compatibility between different pools of open material. It can be summed up in the statement that: “Open means anyone can freely access, use, modify, and share for any purpose (subject, at most, to requirements that preserve provenance and openness).” Put most succinctly: “Open data and content can be freely used, modified, and shared by anyone for any purpose” Read the full Open Definition » Close menu
